attempts.summary: Built the double-NAT path: node3(lan-a) -> node1(VyOS, SNAT to 10.10.2.1 entering transit) -> node2(OPNsense, SNAT to 10.10.3.254 entering lan-b) -> node4(HTTP:8080). Verified node4's access log records the source as node2's lan-b address (10.10.3.254) exclusively, never node3's or node1's real address. Restarted all four nodes one at a time per the mandatory protocol, confirmed boot-identity change on each, and re-verified the full double-NAT path and service health after every restart.
